ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
PORTRAITS & LIGHT
023
STUDY 034
Warm Glow & Hands at the Chin
Rights check
Source: 24546.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with dark hair in a loose low
bun and soft face-framing strands rests her chin on her
folded hands. She wears a white oversized top with
billowing sleeves and a brown strap at the shoulder.
Her gaze is direct, with a subtle, sultry expression.
Warm amber light falls across her face against a soft,
blurred background. Palette of amber, cream, and deep
brown. Intimate and warm, in the style of a beauty
campaign.
Warm, intimate, sultry
WORKING NOTES
- The hand position and warm light create the intimate
tone.
- Add 'soft focus' for a dreamy effect.
